verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit offers configurable, event-driven behavior within its review domain. `reviews.auto_review` settings trigger reviews on PR events, filtered by keyword, label, branch, draft status and commit count. The request-changes workflow automatically requests changes or approves based on review outcomes. CI/CD failures automatically produce inline fix suggestions, and PRs can be subscribed to events with Slack/Discord notifications. Path and ast-grep instructions define rules applied during reviews, but these steer review content rather than triggering arbitrary actions. Overall the triggers and actions are a fixed, vendor-defined set, not a general rule engine. Missing for 10: user-defined arbitrary event→action rules (e.g. custom triggers firing custom recipes or external webhooks), documentation of a general automation/rule builder, independent hands-on corroboration.
